abstract: This paper examines the reallocation effects of a typical environmental policy aiming to internalize externalities: the straw burning ban across China. The ban prohibited the traditional farming practice of burning straw while compelling the labour‐intensive practice of straw utilization. We show that the legislation banning straw burning led to an increase in local land renting activities. Our results indicate that implementation of the ban resulted in a within‐village land redistribution, encouraging the exit of less‐productive farmers while promoting land expansion by more‐productive farmers. Consequently, village‐level aggregate agricultural output and productivity increased by 5% and 3%, respectively. A complementary policy instrument to the command‐and‐control ban—establishing biomass power plants to incentivize farmers to collect crop residues—led to a greater land redistribution in villages with a nearby biomass power plant after the ban is imposed, relative to before.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了一项旨在内化外部性的典型环境政策——中国秸秆禁烧令——的重新配置效应。该禁令禁止了传统的秸秆焚烧耕作方式，同时强制推行劳动密集型的秸秆利用实践。我们证明，秸秆禁烧立法导致当地土地租赁活动增加。研究结果表明，禁令的实施引发了村内土地重新分配，促使低生产率农户退出，同时推动高生产率农户扩大土地规模。由此，村级农业总产出和生产率分别提升了5%和3%。作为命令控制型禁令的补充政策工具——建立生物质发电厂以激励农户收集农作物残余物——在禁令实施后，相较于实施前，导致邻近生物质发电厂的村庄出现了更显著的土地重新分配。

title: Reallocation Effects of Internalizing Externalities: Evidence From China's Straw Burning Ban

abstract: In this paper, we investigate how competition among NGOs to attract donations shapes the incentives that NGOs provide to their employees. NGOs hire workers to undertake development projects, which are horizontally and vertically differentiated. Workers perform constructive activities that enhance project quality, but can also engage in non‐observable destructive activities that harm the employing organization. NGOs offer monetary incentives to encourage constructive effort, but also need monitoring to curb destructive behavior. Our analysis yields the following results: (i) a high mission orientation on the part of NGOs makes workers' misconduct harder to eliminate; (ii) increased competition in the market for donations leads to higher constructive effort and project quality, but also to greater destructive effort; (iii) relative to the social optimum, the market outcome entails inadequate monitoring and excessive destructive behavior.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了非政府组织（NGO）在吸引捐款的竞争如何影响其向员工提供的激励措施。NGO雇佣工人开展发展项目，这些项目在横向和纵向维度上存在差异。工人从事提升项目质量的建设性活动，但也可能进行损害雇佣组织的不可观测的破坏性活动。NGO通过货币激励鼓励建设性努力，同时需要监督机制遏制破坏性行为。分析得出以下结论：（i）NGO的高使命导向使员工不当行为更难以消除；（ii）捐款市场竞争加剧会提升建设性努力和项目质量，但也会增加破坏性行为；（iii）与社会最优水平相比，市场均衡结果表现为监督不足和过度破坏性行为。
title: Bad NGOs? Competition in the Market for Donations and Workers' Misconduct
title_zh: 不良非政府组织？捐赠市场竞争与员工不当行为

abstract: This article examines how accelerating automation and the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in advanced economies reshape labor markets across the Global South through interconnected channels of production, migration, and remittances. Drawing on the theories and practices of economic geography, labor economics, and development studies, the analysis conceptualizes automation as a transnational shock that contracts demand for migrant labor while simultaneously amplifying employment precarity in labor-surplus economies. The article advances a geographically grounded framework linking technology adoption in core industries with labor displacement, youth unemployment, and urban labor saturation in South Asia and North Africa. It further highlights the macroeconomic vulnerabilities in developing countries arising from remittance dependence and the role of digital media in shaping youth mobilization and political unrest in their native countries. By integrating comparative regional field evidence with a technology–labor–space framework, the study contributes to economic geography by demonstrating how digital transformation reconfigures development patterns across regions and countries. The findings underscore the limits of technology-led growth strategies in labor-abundant contexts and call for employment-centered digital policies that are spatially differentiated and institutionally grounded. Keywords: automation, artificial intelligence, labor markets, remittances, youth unemployment, economic geography, Global South.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了发达经济体加速自动化和人工智能应用如何通过生产、移民和汇款等相互关联的渠道重塑全球南方的劳动力市场。基于经济地理学、劳动经济学和发展研究的理论与实践，本文将自动化概念化为一种跨国冲击，它既压缩了对移民劳动力的需求，同时加剧了劳动力过剩经济体的就业不稳定性。文章提出了一个基于地理视角的分析框架，将核心产业的技术采纳与南亚及北非地区的劳动力转移、青年失业和城市劳动力饱和联系起来。文章进一步强调了发展中国家因依赖汇款而产生的宏观经济脆弱性，以及数字媒体在塑造本国青年动员和政治动荡中的作用。通过将区域比较实地证据与技术—劳动力—空间框架相结合，本研究展示了数字化转型如何重构区域和国家间的发展模式，从而为经济地理学做出贡献。研究结论揭示了在劳动力充裕背景下技术驱动增长战略的局限性，并呼吁制定以就业为中心、具有空间差异性和制度基础的数字政策。关键词：自动化，人工智能，劳动力市场，汇款，青年失业，经济地理学，全球南方。

title: Automation, Migration, and Development: Geography of Job Precarity in South Asia and North Africa
title_zh: 自动化、移民与发展：南亚与北非地区工作不稳定的地理分布

abstract: Sudan’s agricultural sector in 2026 is facing unprecedented challenges due to the ongoing conflict, economic instability, and climate-related shocks. These overlapping crises have severely disrupted farming activities, market systems, and rural livelihoods across the country. The situation is particularly critical for smallholder farmers, who form the backbone of Sudan’s food production and rural economy. This report assesses the state of agriculture in conflict-affected Sudan, with a focus on input use, crop production, market access, and farming household-level challenges. It draws data from the Sudan 2024 Smallholder Farmers Survey, conducted across 13 of Sudan’s 18 states. The survey covered both the 2023/24 winter cropping season and preparations for the 2024 summer season. The findings reveal that Sudan’s agriculture sector has been severely disrupted by the ongoing conflict. Migration and displacement due to the conflict are reshaping the structure of farming households, while asset losses, reduced cultivated land, and declining livestock holdings undermine their resilience. Household incomes have contracted sharply. Engagement in agricultural activities has dropped, while reliance of farming households on non-agricultural businesses, casual labor, and humanitarian assistance has increased. Food insecurity has reached alarming levels—fewer than one in four households are food secure, while over half are severely food insecure. Food-insecure households are most prevalent in conflict-affected states, such as South Kordofan, North Kordofan, and Blue Nile. However, improvements were seen in access to input and output markets and the adoption of agricultural inputs in the 2023/24 winter season compared to the 2023 summer season. Farmers reported better availability of improved seed and fertilizer and more reliable input markets and crop-selling channels. However, these gains are overshadowed by growing uncertainty—a large portion of farmers indicated that they did not plan to cultivate crops during the 2024 summer season. Farmer’s access to finance and external assistance remained highly constrained. Farming households that used credit primarily relied on informal credit sources. More than three-quarters reported receiving no external assistance in 2024. Where support is available, its distribution remains uneven, with conflict-affected areas facing severe delivery challenges. Farmers report widespread exposure to both idiosyncratic and covariate shocks such as illness, flooding, theft, and violence—all of which compound their vulnerability. The coping strategies they use include selling household goods, reducing agricultural investment, or liquidating assets. Such choices provide short-term relief but jeopardize their long-term recovery. Perceptions of insecurity remain widespread, particularly in states experiencing active conflict. Overall, the findings paint a picture of a farming sector under extreme strain in Sudan. Without urgent, state-specific, and conflict-sensitive interventions, rural livelihoods will continue to deteriorate, further threatening national food security. The report concludes with recommendations to strengthen humanitarian support, revitalize agricultural input and finance systems, protect the assets of farming households, restore markets, and invest in building the resilience of farming households to both conflict and climate risks. Tailored interventions are needed to address state-level disparities, including food and security support in the Kordofan region, water and health services in Red Sea and Kassala states, and agricultural inputs in Aj Jazirah and River Nile. Long-term strategies must also invest in climate-smart agriculture, strengthen social protection systems, and ensure conflict-sensitive approaches that protect farmers and rebuild trust in rural communities.
abstract_zh: 2026年，苏丹农业部门因持续冲突、经济不稳定和气候相关冲击面临前所未有的挑战。这些叠加危机严重扰乱了全国范围内的农业活动、市场体系和农村生计。作为苏丹粮食生产和农村经济支柱的小农户处境尤为严峻。本报告评估了受冲突影响的苏丹农业现状，重点关注投入品使用、作物生产、市场准入及农户层面的挑战。数据来源于2024年苏丹小农户调查，覆盖苏丹18个州中的13个州，调查涵盖2023/24年冬季种植季及2024年夏季种植季的准备工作。调查结果显示，苏丹农业部门因持续冲突遭受严重破坏。冲突导致的迁移和流离失所正在重塑农户结构，而资产损失、耕地面积减少及牲畜存栏量下降削弱了其恢复能力。农户收入急剧萎缩，农业活动参与率下降，而对非农经营、临时务工和人道主义援助的依赖程度上升。粮食不安全已达到警戒水平——不足四分之一的农户实现粮食安全，超过半数农户处于严重粮食不安全状态。受冲突影响的州（如南科尔多凡州、北科尔多凡州和青尼罗州）粮食不安全农户比例最高。然而，与2023年夏季相比，2023/24年冬季农户在投入品和产出品市场准入及农业投入品采用方面有所改善。农民报告称改良种子和化肥的可获得性提高，投入品市场和作物销售渠道更加可靠。但这些进展被日益增长的不确定性所掩盖——大部分农民表示未计划在2024年夏季种植作物。农民获得资金和外部援助的渠道仍严重受限。使用信贷的农户主要依赖非正规信贷来源。超过四分之三的农户报告称2024年未获得任何外部援助。即使存在援助，其分配仍不均衡，受冲突影响地区面临严重的交付挑战。农民普遍遭受特质性和协变性冲击（如疾病、洪水、盗窃和暴力），这些冲击加剧了其脆弱性。其应对策略包括出售家庭物品、减少农业投资或变卖资产。此类选择虽能提供短期缓解，但危及长期恢复。不安全感知普遍存在，尤其在持续冲突的州。总体而言，调查结果描绘了苏丹农业部门承受极端压力的图景。若无紧急、针对州情且具有冲突敏感性的干预措施，农村生计将持续恶化，进一步威胁国家粮食安全。报告最后提出建议：加强人道主义支持、振兴农业投入品和金融体系、保护农户资产、恢复市场，并投资建设农户应对冲突和气候风险的韧性。需制定针对性干预措施解决州级差异，包括科尔多凡地区的粮食与安全支持、红海州和卡萨拉州的水资源与卫生服务、杰济拉州和尼罗河州的农业投入品。长期战略必须投资气候智慧型农业、强化社会保障体系，并确保采取保护农民、重建农村社区信任的冲突敏感性方法。

abstract: A broad literature has established the negative effects of teen motherhood on educational outcomes. Yet relatively little is known about the educational effects of becoming a teen father. Using siblings fixed effects on population‐level data from Chile I compare educational outcomes of young teen‐mothers and teen‐fathers and provide new evidence on potential heterogeneous effects. My results show early parenthood has a negative association with most educational outcomes, with worse effects for young teen‐mothers than for teen‐fathers and for individuals from disadvantaged socio‐economic backgrounds. I conclude that appropriate support could help to reduce gender inequalities in the effects of early parenthood.
abstract_zh: 大量文献已证实青少年母亲对教育结果具有负面影响。然而，对于成为青少年父亲的教育影响，人们相对知之甚少。本文利用智利人口层面数据中的同胞固定效应，比较了青少年母亲与青少年父亲的教育结果，并就潜在的异质性效应提供了新的证据。研究结果表明，早育与大多数教育结果呈负相关，且对青少年母亲的影响比青少年父亲更严重，对来自社会经济弱势背景的个体影响也更大。本文得出结论，适当的支持有助于减少早育影响中的性别不平等。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Early Parenthood and Educational Outcomes. Are There Differences Between Young Teenage Mothers and Fathers?
title_zh: 早育与教育结果：青少年母亲与父亲之间是否存在差异？

abstract: We study how working from home (WFH) relates to wages and wage growth. We propose a labor supply framework with WFH and on-site work modes, and an empirical strategy linking work arrangements to wages and wage growth while addressing selection into WFH. We find no statistically significant relationship between WFH and contemporaneous wages. Men with higher WFH intensity experience slower wage growth; estimates for women are not distinguishable from zero. These patterns are unlikely to be explained by occupational composition or selection. The findings are consistent with WFH affecting human capital accumulation inputs, while having limited implications for contemporaneous productivity.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了居家办公（WFH）与工资及工资增长之间的关系。我们构建了一个包含居家办公和现场办公两种工作模式的劳动力供给框架，并提出了一种实证策略，用以关联工作安排与工资及工资增长，同时处理选择进入居家办公的内生性问题。研究发现，居家办公与当期工资之间不存在统计上显著的关系。对于居家办公强度较高的男性，其工资增长速度较慢；而女性的估计结果则与零无显著差异。这些模式不太可能由职业构成或选择性解释。研究结果与居家办公影响人力资本积累要素、但对当期生产率影响有限的看法相一致。
title: Working From Home and Wage Dynamics
title_zh: 居家办公与工资动态

abstract: We examine the impact of changes in testing standards on the new teacher pipeline by exploiting a quasi-experimental change in the minimum passing score required for admission into teacher training programs. Using institution-level data, we find that higher testing standards sharply reduce teacher preparation program enrollments and graduations. Increases in testing standards are also associated with declines in the number of new teacher licenses awarded. According to our estimates, the average increase in standards led to a nine percent decrease in graduations from teacher training programs, accounting for more than one-third of the overall decline in teacher training graduates.
abstract_zh: 我们通过利用教师培训项目入学最低通过分数的一项准实验性变化，考察了考试标准变动对新教师输送渠道的影响。基于机构层面的数据，我们发现，提高考试标准显著减少了教师培训项目的注册人数和毕业人数。考试标准的提升还与新教师执照颁发数量的下降相关联。根据我们的估算，标准平均提高导致教师培训项目毕业人数减少9%，这占教师培训毕业生总体下降数量的三分之一以上。
title: Teacher Testing Standards and the New Teacher Pipeline
title_zh: 教师考试标准与新手教师培养渠道

abstract: Individual Fishing Quotas (IFQs) have the potential to lead to higher ex‐vessel prices by reducing market gluts and improving product quality. While IFQs have been introduced in a number of fisheries in recent decades, few causal studies investigate their price effects. Using synthetic control methods on US reef‐fish fisheries, we show that IFQs significantly increase prices for red snapper, red grouper, gag grouper, yellowedge grouper, scamp grouper, and tilefish. We also find significant positive price spillovers to adjacent, untreated fisheries. A primary challenge to unbiased estimation using synthetic control is treatment spillover, which can contaminate both never‐treated units in the donor pool and to‐be‐treated units in a staggered implementation. When control (donor) units are subject to these spillovers, this can lead to either attenuation or divergence of the causal estimate, depending on the empirical setting. To address this estimation challenge, we propose a framework relying on economic theory (market arbitrage and product substitution) and empirical analysis (e.g., market integration or demand estimation) to inform both donor selection and the timing of the treatment start date. As a result, our proposed structure improves the accuracy of synthetic control estimates, as shown by a small Monte Carlo experiment. Furthermore, by pre‐identifying contaminated units, our framework allows for the direct measurement of the spillover effects themselves.
abstract_zh: 个人捕捞配额（IFQs）可能通过减少市场过剩和改善产品质量来提高离岸价格。尽管近几十年来多个渔业已引入IFQs，但关于其价格效应的因果研究仍较为匮乏。通过在美国礁石鱼类渔业中应用合成控制方法，我们发现IFQs显著提高了红鲷鱼、红石斑鱼、黑斑石斑鱼、黄边石斑鱼、斑纹石斑鱼和方头鱼的价格。同时，我们还发现IFQs对邻近未受政策影响的渔业产生了显著的正向价格溢出效应。使用合成控制方法进行无偏估计的主要挑战在于处理溢出效应——这种效应可能污染供体池中从未受处理的单元，以及在分阶段实施中即将受处理的单元。当控制（供体）单元受到这些溢出效应影响时，因果估计可能产生衰减或发散，具体取决于实证环境。为应对这一估计挑战，我们提出一个基于经济理论（市场套利与产品替代）和实证分析（如市场整合或需求估计）的框架，以指导供体选择和处理起始时间的确定。通过小型蒙特卡洛实验验证，我们提出的结构显著提升了合成控制估计的准确性。此外，通过预先识别受污染的单元，该框架还能直接测量溢出效应本身。
title: An economic approach to mitigating spillover bias in synthetic control methods: An application to the price effects of fishing quotas
title_zh: 减轻合成控制法中溢出偏差的经济学方法：以捕捞配额价格效应为例

abstract: Pay-TV firms compete both downstream to attract viewers and upstream to acquire broadcasting rights. Because profits inherited from downstream competition satisfy a convexity property, allocating rights to the dominant firm maximizes the industry profit. Such an exclusive allocation of rights emerges as a robust equilibrium outcome but may fail to maximize welfare. We analyze whether a ban on resale and a ban on package bidding may improve welfare. These corrective policies have no impact on the final allocation but lead to profit redistribution along the value chain.
abstract_zh: 付费电视企业在下游争夺观众，同时在上游竞争获取转播权。由于下游竞争所继承的利润满足凸性性质，将转播权分配给主导企业可实现行业利润最大化。这种排他性的转播权分配作为稳健的均衡结果出现，但可能无法实现福利最大化。我们分析禁止转售和禁止组合投标是否能改善福利。这些矫正性政策对最终分配没有影响，但会导致价值链上的利润再分配。
title: Why Is Exclusivity in Broadcasting Rights Prevalent and Why Does Simple Regulation Fail?
title_zh: 为何广播权排他性普遍存在且简单监管为何失效？

abstract: We study strategic trading by a privately informed blockholder who monitors a company and trades its shares. Private information results in larger block sizes in good states, but by increasing the speed of the blockholder's selling, it can result in lower block sizes in bad states. Despite the heterogeneous impact on expected block size, we show that asymmetric information leads to Pareto improvements: it raises stock prices, benefits small uninformed shareholders, and benefits the block owner, despite the negative impact on liquidity.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一位拥有私人信息的控股股东的战略性交易行为，该股东既监督公司又交易其股份。私人信息在良好状态下导致更大的持股规模，但通过加快控股股东的卖出速度，在不利状态下可能导致持股规模减小。尽管对预期持股规模的影响存在异质性，我们表明信息不对称带来了帕累托改进：它提高了股价，惠及小型不知情股东，并有利于控股股东，尽管对流动性产生了负面影响。
title: Strategic Trading and Blockholder Dynamics
title_zh: 战略交易与大宗股东动态

abstract: A platform matches a unit mass of sellers, each owning a single product of heterogeneous quality, to a unit mass of buyers with differing valuations for unit-quality. After matching, sellers make take-it-or-leave-it price-offers to buyers. Initially, valuations of buyers are only known to them and the platform, but sellers make inferences from the matching algorithm. The efficient matching is positive assortative, but buyer-optimal matchings are stochastically negative assortative when there are few low-value buyers (i.e., compared to lower-quality sellers, high-quality ones are matched to buyers with lower expected valuation). Although everyone trades, generating rents for the side lacking bargaining power results in inefficient matching.
abstract_zh: 平台将单位质量的卖方（每位卖方拥有一件质量异质的产品）与单位质量的买方（对单位质量具有不同估值）进行匹配。匹配完成后，卖方对买方提出“要么接受，要么放弃”的价格报价。初始时，买方的估值仅为其自身和平台所知，但卖方会从匹配算法中进行推断。有效匹配是正选择性的，但当低价值买方数量较少时（即与低质量卖方相比，高质量卖方匹配到的买方预期估值更低），买方最优匹配在随机意义上是负选择性的。尽管所有交易均能达成，但为缺乏议价能力的一方创造租金会导致匹配效率低下。
title: Buyer‐Optimal Platform Design
title_zh: 买家最优的平台设计

abstract: A long-lived seller sells a new product of unknown value by offering prices and recommendations to short-lived consumers in continuous time. The seller receives consumer feedback about the product at a rate that increases with the instantaneous sales volume. The optimal selling mechanism features episodes of price discounts, during which the seller discontinuously lowers the price and offers unwarranted recommendations to consumers. The optimal pricing strategy depends on the nature of consumer feedback and may involve early or late discounts, dynamic price backtracking, and below-cost pricing.
abstract_zh: 长期存在的卖方通过连续时间内的定价与推荐，向短视消费者销售价值未知的新产品。卖方接收消费者反馈的速度随瞬时销售量增加而加快。最优销售机制包含价格折扣阶段，在此期间卖方非连续地降低价格并向消费者提供无依据的推荐。最优定价策略取决于消费者反馈的性质，可能涉及早期或晚期折扣、动态价格回溯及低于成本的定价。
title: Dynamic Pricing With Recommendation and Consumer Feedback
title_zh: 基于推荐与消费者反馈的动态定价

abstract: We analyze a dynamic model of repeated innovation where inventors may either be acquired by an incumbent or else resist takeover and challenge for leadership. In the short run, acquisitions always spur innovation because of the invention-for-buyout effect. In the longer run, however, they may stifle it because of a countervailing effect, the entrenchment of monopoly. The latter occurs when the incumbent's dominance depends on past levels of activity and is therefore reinforced by recurrent acquisitions. We show that if the entrenchment effect is sufficiently strong, forward-looking policymakers should prohibit acquisitions in anticipation of the long-run negative impact on innovation. This argument sets out a new theory of harm that can be used to block acquisitions that could otherwise go unchallenged.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个重复创新的动态模型，其中发明者可能被现有企业收购，或者抵制收购并挑战领导地位。短期内，收购总能通过“发明-购买”效应刺激创新。然而，从长远来看，由于一种抵消效应——垄断的固化，收购可能会抑制创新。当现有企业的支配地位依赖于过去的活跃水平，并因此被反复收购所强化时，就会出现这种固化效应。我们证明，如果固化效应足够强，前瞻性的政策制定者应预见收购对创新的长期负面影响而予以禁止。这一论点提出了一种新的损害理论，可用于阻止那些否则可能不受质疑的收购。
title: Acquisitions, Innovation and the Entrenchment of Monopoly
title_zh: 收购、创新与垄断地位的固化

abstract: Influencers, from propagandists to sellers, expend vast resources targeting agents who amplify their message through word-of-mouth communication. While agents differ in network position, they also differ in their bias: Agents may naturally read articles with a particular slant or buy products from a certain seller. Absent competition, an influencer prefers targeting central agents and those biased against it. If agents are unbiased, competition leads to influencers targeting more central agents. However, when agents have heterogeneous biases and competition is intense, the incentive to deter one's rival dominates. Influencers protect their base, targeting those with similar beliefs in equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 从宣传者到销售者，影响者投入大量资源瞄准那些通过口碑传播放大其信息的代理人。尽管代理人在网络位置上有差异，他们在偏见上也各不相同：代理人可能自然倾向于阅读特定倾向的文章或从特定卖家购买产品。在没有竞争的情况下，影响者偏好瞄准中心代理人及那些对其有偏见的代理人。若代理人无偏见，竞争促使影响者瞄准更中心的代理人。然而，当代理人具有异质性偏见且竞争激烈时，遏制对手的动机占据主导。影响者保护其基本盘，在均衡状态下瞄准信念相近的代理人。
title: Strategic Influencers and the Shaping of Beliefs
title_zh: 战略影响者与信念塑造

abstract: A privately informed sender can commit to any disclosure policy toward a receiver, whose actions affect the utility of the sender. We show that full disclosure is optimal under a sufficient condition with some desirable properties. First, it speaks directly to the parties' utility functions, as opposed to the sender's indirect utility function; this makes it easily interpretable and verifiable. Second, it does not require the sender's payoff to be a function of the posterior mean state. Third, it is weaker than the conditions obtained in the literature for some specific settings.
abstract_zh: 拥有私人信息的发送者可以向接收者承诺任何信息披露政策，而接收者的行为会影响发送者的效用。我们证明，在具备某些理想性质的充分条件下，完全披露是最优的。首先，该条件直接针对双方的效用函数，而非发送者的间接效用函数，因此易于解释和验证。其次，它不要求发送者的收益是后验均值状态的函数。第三，它比文献中针对某些特定情境所得出的条件更为宽松。
title: On the Optimality of Full Disclosure
title_zh: 论完全披露的最优性

abstract: We study a long-horizon, oligopolistic market with random shocks to demand that can be arbitraged by two storage operators with finite capacity. This problem applies to any storable commodity—that is, most commodities. Because the arbitrage spread is so sensitive to market power, storage operators face strong incentives to restrain quantities by tacitly colluding. This cooperation takes new forms thanks to the multiplicity of actions they must take: selling, buying, or both. We construct payoff-maximizing equilibria of this stochastic game, and uncover a new form of Partial Cooperation that trades off quantities and delay. While collusive, Partial Cooperation delivers higher consumer surplus thanks to the market power effect. Head-on competition is not always an equilibrium of the long-horizon game when market power becomes large enough. We draw implications for policy and suggest poorly competitive storage is a negative externality to the development of the underlying commodity—for example, renewable energy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个长期视野下的寡头垄断市场，其中需求受到随机冲击，而两家具有有限容量的存储运营商可以通过套利来应对这些冲击。此问题适用于任何可储存商品——即大多数商品。由于套利价差对市场力量极为敏感，存储运营商面临通过默契合谋来限制数量的强烈激励。鉴于他们必须采取多种行动——出售、购买或两者兼有，这种合作呈现出新的形式。我们构建了该随机博弈中的利润最大化均衡，并揭示了一种新的部分合作形式，它在数量与延迟之间进行权衡。尽管属于合谋性质，部分合作因市场力量效应而带来了更高的消费者剩余。当市场力量足够大时，正面竞争并不总是长期博弈中的均衡状态。我们为政策制定提供了启示，并指出存储领域竞争不足对基础商品——例如可再生能源——的发展构成了一种负外部性。
title: Storage games
title_zh: 存储博弈

abstract: Biased recommendations arise naturally in markets with heterogeneous consumers. We study a model in which a monopolist offers an experience good to a population of consumers with heterogeneous tastes and makes personalized purchase recommendations. We provide conditions under which a firm makes welfare-reducing purchase recommendations with positive probability, resulting in inflated recommendations. We extend this insight to a setting in which an intermediary makes the recommendations, whereas a seller sets the retail price. Regulatory interventions that forbid inflated recommendations may lead to higher social welfare or may backfire.
abstract_zh: 在消费者偏好异质的市场中，偏见性推荐自然产生。我们研究了一个模型，其中垄断者向具有异质品味的消费者群体提供体验品，并做出个性化购买推荐。我们给出了企业在正概率下做出降低福利的购买推荐的条件，导致推荐膨胀。我们将这一见解扩展到中介机构做出推荐、而卖家设定零售价格的情境。禁止膨胀推荐的监管干预可能提高社会福利，也可能适得其反。
title: Inflated Recommendations
title_zh: 膨胀的推荐

abstract: I estimate a Bayesian persuasion model to examine how financial incentives and asymmetric information shape physician–patient interactions. This approach offers new insights into the role of insurance. First, the model predicts that patients' coinsurance moderates physicians' responsiveness to increases in service fees. This prediction is supported by a difference-in-differences analysis using Chinese health insurance claims data with random variation in physicians' reimbursement and patients' coinsurance rates. Second, the model implies that lower coinsurance rates reduce both patient price elasticity and skepticism, increasing the likelihood of physicians misdirecting patients toward unnecessary treatments. Using structural model estimates, I show that for a diagnosis where surgical treatment is discretionary, nearly half of the patients who received surgery would not have done so were they fully informed. Such misdirection from physicians is greater when coinsurance rates decrease, highlighting a new inefficiency channel beyond moral hazard. I decompose the effect of lowering coinsurance into moral hazard and the novel greater misdirection effect. Counterfactual analysis shows that, while patients benefit from lower out-of-pocket costs, greater misdirection nearly offsets these welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 我估计了一个贝叶斯说服模型，以考察经济激励和信息不对称如何塑造医患互动。这一方法为理解保险的作用提供了新视角。首先，模型预测患者的共付比例会调节医生对服务费用增加的响应程度。这一预测得到了基于中国健康保险索赔数据的双重差分分析的支持，该数据中医生报销比例和患者共付比例存在随机变动。其次，模型暗示较低的共付比例会降低患者的价格敏感性和怀疑程度，从而增加医生将患者误导至不必要治疗的可能性。利用结构模型估计，我表明对于手术属于可选择性治疗的诊断，近半数接受手术的患者若完全知情则不会选择手术。当共付比例下降时，医生的此类误导行为更为严重，这凸显了道德风险之外的一个新的效率损失渠道。我将降低共付比例的影响分解为道德风险和新的更大误导效应。反事实分析显示，尽管患者从较低的自付费用中获益，但更大的误导效应几乎抵消了这些福利收益。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Physicians as Persuaders: Evidence from Hospitals in China
title_zh: 医生作为说服者：来自中国医院的证据

abstract: While conservation goals have long been pursued through traditional species-augmenting actions, a broader set of episodic ecosystem modification (EEM) actions, such as hydropower dam releases, prescribed fire, and beach nourishment, is garnering attention. EEM actions face several implementation challenges stemming from high opportunity costs, delayed effect mechanisms, reliance on monitoring for deployment timing, and outcome uncertainty due to infrequent use. In this paper, we study the use of EEM actions in the form of designer flows—ecologically-motivated releases of water into regulated river segments—to maintain a viable population of a threatened native fish species in the Colorado River. We demonstrate how the cost-effectiveness of EEM actions can be hampered by the complex and delayed effects on species viability, but enhanced through targeted monitoring for timing deployment and experimentation for reducing uncertainty about effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 长期以来，保护目标一直通过传统的物种增殖行动来实现，然而，一系列更广泛的间歇性生态系统改造（EEM）行动，如水力发电大坝泄流、计划烧除和海滩养护，正日益受到关注。EEM行动面临若干实施挑战，这些挑战源于高昂的机会成本、延迟的效应机制、依赖监测来确定部署时机，以及因使用频率低而导致的结果不确定性。本文研究了以设计流量形式——即出于生态动机向受管制河段放水——实施的EEM行动，用以维持科罗拉多河中一种受威胁本土鱼类种群的生存能力。我们展示了EEM行动的成本效益如何因对物种生存能力的复杂且延迟的影响而受到制约，但通过有针对性的监测以确定部署时机和通过实验减少效果不确定性，其成本效益可以得到提升。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 138
title: Timing, uncertainty, and opportunity cost: Lessons for ecosystem modification on the Colorado River
title_zh: 时机、不确定性与机会成本：科罗拉多河生态系统改造的启示

abstract: This paper introduces a hierarchical Large Language Model (LLM) framework for the automated identification of narrative fiscal shocks. We develop a multi-stage architecture to extract austerity episodes from IMF Article IV reports (2004–2020) for 17 OECD countries. Relative to manual coding, our approach improves replicability and auditability by generating a documented sequence of classification steps. Benchmarking against Adler et al. (2024), we find that the LLM-based classification aligns closely with the narrative benchmark, while differing on a small subset of episodes. Local projection estimates indicate that LLM-identified shocks are associated with smaller estimated multipliers than the narrative benchmark, with the difference linked in large part to differences in shock persistence and endogeneity.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种分层大型语言模型（LLM）框架，用于自动识别叙事性财政冲击。我们构建了一个多阶段架构，从17个OECD国家2004至2020年间的IMF第四条磋商报告中提取紧缩时期。相较于人工编码，我们的方法通过生成一系列有记录的分类步骤，提高了可复制性和可审计性。与Adler等人（2024）的基准相比，我们发现基于LLM的分类与叙事基准高度一致，但在少数事件上存在差异。局部投影估计表明，LLM识别的冲击所对应的乘数估计值小于叙事基准，这一差异在很大程度上与冲击的持续性和内生性差异有关。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Identifying episodes of fiscal austerity: An LLM-based approach
title_zh: 识别财政紧缩时期：基于大语言模型的方法

abstract: Using a novel measure of investment companies’ reliance on generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), we document a sharp increase in GenAI usage by hedge funds after ChatGPT’s 2022 launch. A difference-in-differences test shows that hedge funds adopting GenAI earn 2-4% higher annualized abnormal returns than nonadopters, while non-hedge funds do not benefit. The outperformance originates from funds’ AI talent and ChatGPT’s strength in analyzing firm-specific information. We conduct a new survey of fund managers’ GenAI usage to provide direct validation of our measure and offer additional new insights on how managers adopt GenAI tools in their practice. (JEL C81, G11, G14, G23)
abstract_zh: 利用投资公司对生成式人工智能（GenAI）依赖程度的新型度量指标，我们记录了2022年ChatGPT发布后对冲基金对GenAI使用量的急剧增长。双重差分检验表明，采用GenAI的对冲基金相较于未采用者，年化异常收益率高出2-4%，而非对冲基金并未从中获益。这种超额收益源于基金的AI人才储备以及ChatGPT在分析企业特定信息方面的优势。我们通过对基金经理GenAI使用情况的新调查，为这一度量指标提供了直接验证，并就基金经理如何在实践中采用GenAI工具提供了额外的新见解。（JEL分类号：C81, G11, G14, G23）
title: Generative AI and Asset Management
title_zh: 生成式人工智能与资产管理

abstract: Béal et al. (Int J Game Theory 54:12, 2025) introduce the Diversity Owen value for TU-games with diversity constraints, and provide axiomatic characterizations using the axioms of fairness and balanced contributions. However, there exist logical flaws in the proofs of the uniqueness of these characterizations. In this note we provide the corrected proofs of the characterizations by introducing the null player for diverse games axiom. Also, we establish an alternative characterization of the Diversity Owen value by modifying the axioms of the above characterizations.
abstract_zh: Béal等人（Int J Game Theory 54:12, 2025）针对具有多样性约束的TU博弈引入了多样性Owen值，并利用公平性和平衡贡献公理给出了公理化刻画。然而，这些刻画唯一性证明中存在逻辑缺陷。在本注记中，我们通过引入多样性博弈的零参与者公理，提供了修正后的刻画证明。此外，我们通过修改上述刻画的公理，建立了多样性Owen值的另一种刻画。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: A note on the Diversity Owen value
title_zh: 关于多样性Owen值的一个注记

abstract_zh: © 2026 作者。由 Elsevier Inc. 出版。这是一篇根据 CC BY 许可（http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/）发布的开放获取文章。
title: Persuasion of interacting receivers
title_zh: 互动接收者的说服

abstract: Dominant platforms like Booking.com have often imposed Price Parity Clauses to prevent lower prices on alternative sales channels. We provide quasi-experimental evidence on the removal of these price restrictions in France in 2015 for three major global hotel groups. Our analysis reveals limited and non-significant price effects for rooms sold through consumer-visible channels, such as hotels’ websites or online travel agencies. However, we document a significant price reduction on sales channels not visible to consumers, such as direct offline bookings. Additionally, we identify a significant shift in the share of bookings from online travel agencies to the hotels’ direct offline channels.
abstract_zh: 像Booking.com这样的主导平台经常实施价格一致性条款，以防止替代销售渠道出现更低价格。我们针对2015年法国三大全球酒店集团取消这些价格限制的情况，提供了准实验证据。分析显示，对于通过消费者可见渠道（如酒店官网或在线旅行社）销售的客房，价格影响有限且不显著。然而，我们发现，在消费者不可见的销售渠道（如直接线下预订）上，价格显著下降。此外，我们还发现预订份额从在线旅行社显著转向酒店的直接线下渠道。
title: The Price Effects of Prohibiting Price Parity Clauses: Evidence from Global Hotel Chains
title_zh: 禁止价格平价条款的价格效应：来自全球连锁酒店的证据

abstract: Theory predicts that outsourcing public services to the private sector can reduce costs and improve efficiency, but can also induce cost-cutting and compromise quality. We assess the Brazilian “Organizações Sociais de Saude” model (OSS), which outsources management of public hospital services to the private sector while the state remains the residual claimant. We show that this enhances hospital production and operational efficiency without adverse effects on hospital quality and equity. Increased inpatient production addresses previously unmet demand, expanding local access to hospital care and reducing population mortality. Performance gains arise from improved operational efficiency achieved through increased hospital management capacity. This facilitates staffing adjustments, favoring higher-skilled personnel, dismissing lower-productivity staff, and adopting flexible, performance-tied employment contracts. Effects are larger among private organizations with more management experience, underscoring returns to managerial capacity. Our findings show that incentive-ownership structures can address the quantity-quality trade-off in public service delivery, even when contracts are incomplete and quality is hard to measure.
abstract_zh: 理论预测，将公共服务外包给私营部门可降低成本并提高效率，但也可能引发成本削减并损害服务质量。我们评估了巴西的"健康社会组织"（OSS）模式——该模式将公立医院管理服务外包给私营部门，而国家仍保留剩余索取权。研究表明，该模式提升了医院产出与运营效率，且未对医院质量与公平性产生负面影响。住院服务量的增加满足了此前未被满足的需求，扩大了当地医院服务的可及性，并降低了人口死亡率。绩效提升源于医院管理能力增强带来的运营效率改善，这促进了人员结构调整——优先雇佣高技能人员、解雇低生产率员工，并采用灵活且与绩效挂钩的雇佣合同。在管理经验更丰富的私营组织中，效果更为显著，凸显了管理能力的回报。我们的发现表明，即使合同不完善且质量难以衡量，激励性所有权结构仍能解决公共服务供给中的数量-质量权衡问题。
title: Public Services Under Private Management
title_zh: 私营管理下的公共服务

abstract: How does proximity to coworkers affect training and productivity? We study software engineers at a Fortune 500 firm from 2019 to 2024, leveraging two shocks to proximity: (i) the office closures in 2020 and (ii) the subsequent return-to-office mandates in 2022 and 2023. In both cases, co-located teams experienced bigger changes in proximity than distributed ones, facilitating difference-in-differences designs. We find that sitting near teammates increases coding feedback by 18.3% and improves code quality. Gains are concentrated among less-tenured and younger employees, who are building human capital. However, there is a tradeoff: experienced engineers write less code when sitting near teammates. In national US data, we find evidence that the rise of remote work has had scarring effects on young college graduates. In remotable jobs, young graduates’ unemployment rate increased relative to older graduates’ post-pandemic (2022−2024) compared to pre-pandemic (2017−2019), a pattern we do not observe in non-remotable jobs.
abstract_zh: 与同事的邻近性如何影响培训与生产力？我们以2019至2024年间某《财富》500强企业的软件工程师为研究对象，利用两次邻近性冲击：（i）2020年办公室关闭，以及（ii）随后2022至2023年重返办公室的强制要求。在这两种情形下，同地办公团队比分布式团队经历了更大的邻近性变化，这为双重差分设计提供了便利。研究发现，与队友相邻而坐可使编码反馈增加18.3%，并提升代码质量。这些收益主要集中于资历较浅和较年轻的员工，他们正处于人力资本积累阶段。然而，存在一个权衡：经验丰富的工程师在邻近队友就座时编写的代码量会减少。在全美数据中，我们发现远程办公的兴起对年轻大学毕业生产生了持续影响。在可远程办公的岗位中，年轻毕业生在疫情后时期（2022-2024年）的失业率相较于疫情前（2017-2019年）高于年长毕业生，而这一模式在不可远程办公的岗位中并未出现。
title: The Power of Proximity to Coworkers
title_zh: 同事邻近性的力量

abstract: This article investigates how a government should manage international reserves when it faces the risk of a rollover crisis. We ask: Should the government accumulate reserves or reduce debt to make itself less vulnerable? We show that the optimal policy entails initially reducing debt, followed by a subsequent increase in both debt and reserves as the government approaches a safe zone. Furthermore, we find that issuing additional debt to accumulate reserves can lead to a reduction in sovereign spreads. Evidence from a panel of emerging economies is consistent with these predictions: increases in reserves financed by public external borrowing are associated with lower spreads, and reserve holdings are not systematically drawn down during crisis episodes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究政府面临展期危机风险时应如何管理国际储备。我们提出的问题是：政府应通过积累储备还是减少债务来降低自身脆弱性？研究表明，最优政策路径是先减少债务，随后在政府接近安全区域时同步增加债务与储备。此外，我们发现通过增发债务来积累储备可降低主权利差。来自新兴经济体的面板数据与这些预测一致：由公共外部借款融资的储备增加与利差下降相关，且危机期间储备持有量并未系统性减少。
title: International Reserve Management Under Rollover Crises
title_zh: 滚动危机下的国际储备管理

abstract: The seminal paper by Baron and Ferejohn (1989) leaves significant gaps in our understanding of open rule bargaining. We aim to fill these gaps by providing a fresh analysis of open rule bargaining. Our approach relies on an appealing class of stationary equilibria. In this class, we show that delays tend to be longer and allocations tend to be less egalitarian than originally predicted by Baron and Ferejohn. Our results shed new light on the efficiency and fairness implications of using an open vs. closed rule in legislatures and of bargaining processes in general.
abstract_zh: Baron与Ferejohn（1989）的开创性论文在开放规则谈判领域留下了显著的研究空白。本文旨在通过提供对开放规则谈判的全新分析来填补这些空白。我们的研究方法依赖于一类具有吸引力的稳态均衡。在该均衡类别中，我们证明谈判延迟往往比Baron与Ferejohn最初预测的更久，而资源分配则更不平均。这一发现为立法机构中开放规则与封闭规则的使用效率及公平性影响，以及更广泛的谈判过程提供了全新视角。
title: Open Rule Legislative Bargaining
title_zh: 公开规则立法谈判

abstract: Countries are increasingly benchmarking food assistance and labour laws on the cost of nationally recommended diets. Benchmarking is made against national annual estimates, which fail to account for sub-national and intra-annual variation in cost, blunting the impact of policies. Using monthly market price data collected by the Government of Rwanda (April 2019-March 2024), we estimate the cost of the country’s proposed food-based dietary guidelines, using a standardised diet costing methodology. We found rural areas experienced greater inflation in diet cost over the study period than urban areas (41% vs 28%), yet the recommended diet was 12.7% higher in urban locations. Diet costs were approximately 6% lower in districts with international border crossings to Tanzania, but 7% more in those with borders with the Democratic Republic of Congo. Fruits and vegetables (110% and 71%) and starchy staples (86% and 83%) contributed most to cost increases in rural and urban locations respectively. Seasonal diet cost fluctuations were also evident with a seasonal amplitude of 5.6% and 6.9% in rural and urban locations, synchronised to Rwanda’s agricultural calendar. 70% of employed Rwandans would find the recommended diet unaffordable, if spending 52% of wages on food. Diet costs varied 4.2-fold across all districts throughout the study period, meaning that uniform national policies to address costs and affordability would be systematically inadequate in high-cost settings and wasteful in low-cost ones. That such spatial–temporal variation exists in a small, relatively market integrated country like Rwanda suggests variation would be at least equally consequential in other low and lower-middle-income countries. High-frequency and sub-national monitoring of prices, diet costs, and affordability provides essential intelligence for policymakers to enable spatially and seasonally targeted interventions, improving both the adequacy and efficiency of food policy.
abstract_zh: 各国日益以国家推荐膳食的成本为基准，来制定食品援助和劳动法规。然而，这种基准设定基于国家年度估算，未能反映次国家级和年内成本变动，从而削弱了政策效果。利用卢旺达政府收集的月度市场价格数据（2019年4月至2024年3月），我们采用标准化膳食成本计算方法，估算了该国拟议的以食物为基础的膳食指南的成本。研究发现，在研究期间，农村地区的膳食成本通胀率高于城市地区（41%对28%），但城市地区的推荐膳食成本高出12.7%。在与坦桑尼亚接壤的边境地区，膳食成本约低6%，而与刚果民主共和国接壤的地区则高出7%。水果和蔬菜（农村和城市分别上涨110%和71%）以及淀粉类主食（分别上涨86%和83%）是成本上涨的主要贡献因素。季节性膳食成本波动也显而易见，农村和城市地区的季节性振幅分别为5.6%和6.9%，与卢旺达的农业日历同步。如果卢旺达就业人口将工资的52%用于食品支出，70%的人将无法负担推荐膳食。在整个研究期间，各地区间的膳食成本差异高达4.2倍，这意味着统一的国家政策在应对成本和可负担性问题上，在高成本地区将系统性不足，在低成本地区则造成浪费。像卢旺达这样面积小、市场相对一体化的国家尚且存在如此显著的时空差异，这表明在其他低收入和中等偏低收入国家，这种差异至少同样重要。高频次和次国家级的价格、膳食成本及可负担性监测，为政策制定者提供了关键信息，有助于实施空间和季节针对性的干预措施，从而提高食品政策的充分性和效率。
title: Cost and affordability of recommended diets in Rwanda using [near] real-time market data
title_zh: 使用[近]实时市场数据的卢旺达推荐膳食成本与可负担性

abstract: Bitcoin contributes to global carbon emissions on a scale comparable to entire countries in order to secure its decentralized network. This exposes Bitcoin to climate policies aimed at reducing emissions. This paper develops a general equilibrium framework to examine how the stringency of climate policy affects Bitcoin’s valuation and its relationship with the equity market. Our theoretical analysis delivers a key insight: a transition from a lenient to a stringent climate policy increases the conditional correlation between Bitcoin and equity returns, thereby compromising Bitcoin’s appeal as a hedge or diversifier against equity market volatility. Empirical evidence supports this theoretical prediction.
abstract_zh: 比特币为维护其去中心化网络所产生的全球碳排放量，其规模堪比整个国家，这使其面临旨在减少排放的气候政策的影响。本文构建了一个一般均衡框架，用以考察气候政策的严格程度如何影响比特币的估值及其与股票市场的关系。我们的理论分析得出一个关键见解：从宽松气候政策向严格气候政策的转变，会提高比特币与股票收益之间的条件相关性，从而削弱比特币作为对冲或分散股票市场波动工具的吸引力。实证证据支持了这一理论预测。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: Bitcoin growth amid climate change: Policy and investment implications
title_zh: 气候变化背景下的比特币增长：政策与投资启示

abstract: This paper examines how pandemic and physical climate risks can co-evolve endogenously and jointly shape macroeconomic, financial, and environmental outcomes. It introduces CliMaPan Lab, an agent-based framework that incorporates epidemiological dynamics and a channel linking emissions, atmospheric concentrations, and temperature within a macroeconomic-financial environment featuring heterogeneous households and firms, as well as adaptive behavior. The framework is designed to capture non-linear propagation and state dependence under alternative public-health interventions. Simulation results show that stronger contact suppression is associated with faster infection control, but also with larger contemporaneous contractions in GDP and consumption, alongside weaker credit activity. Vaccination-centered regimes, and to a lesser extent social distancing, are associated with fewer severe outcomes and comparatively smoother macroeconomic and credit trajectories when protection accumulates sufficiently early. When physical climate risk is activated, cumulative damages weaken economic performance and increase persistence, with larger disruptions under compound scenarios where pandemic-related labor-market frictions interact with climate-related production losses. Emissions decline during pandemic disruptions but rebound as activity normalizes. Under compound risk, more persistent emissions reductions primarily reflect prolonged economic weakness rather than an endogenous decarbonization transition. Overall, the findings indicate that compound risks can generate non-additive, path-dependent dynamics that are not captured by single-risk analyses.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了疫情风险与物理气候风险如何内生地共同演化，并联合影响宏观经济、金融及环境结果。研究引入了CliMaPan Lab框架，这是一个基于主体的模型体系，整合了流行病学动态以及排放、大气浓度与温度之间的关联渠道，置于包含异质性家庭与企业及适应性行为的宏观经济-金融环境中。该框架旨在捕捉不同公共卫生干预措施下的非线性传导与状态依赖性。模拟结果显示，更强的接触抑制措施虽能加速感染控制，但同时也伴随当期GDP与消费的更大收缩，以及信贷活动的减弱。以疫苗接种为核心的机制，以及程度较轻的社交距离措施，在保护措施足够早积累的情况下，与较少的严重结果及相对更平稳的宏观经济和信贷轨迹相关联。当物理气候风险被激活时，累积损害削弱经济表现并增强持续性，在疫情相关劳动力市场摩擦与气候相关生产损失相互作用的复合情景下，干扰更为显著。疫情期间排放量下降，但随着经济活动正常化而反弹。在复合风险下，更持久的排放减少主要反映的是长期经济疲软，而非内生脱碳转型。总体而言，研究结果表明，复合风险能产生非加总、路径依赖的动态效应，这些效应是单一风险分析无法捕捉的。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 189
title: When pandemics meet climate risk: An agent-based model of non-linear macroeconomic dynamics under compound stress
title_zh: 当流行病遇上气候风险：复合压力下非线性宏观经济动态的基于主体模型

abstract: We analyze 18 quadrillion models for the joint pricing of corporate bond and stock returns. Strikingly, we find that equity and nontradable factors alone suffice to explain corporate bond risk premia once their Treasury term structure risk is accounted for, rendering the extensive bond factor literature largely redundant for this purpose. While only a handful of factors, behavioral and nontradable, are likely robust sources of priced risk, the true latent stochastic discount factor is dense in the space of observable factors. Consequently, a Bayesian Model Averaging Stochastic Discount Factor explains risk premia better than all low-dimensional models, in- and out-of-sample, by optimally aggregating dozens of factors that serve as noisy proxies for common underlying risks, yielding an out-of-sample Sharpe ratio of 1.5 to 1.8. This SDF, as well as its conditional mean and volatility, are persistent, track the business cycle and times of heightened economic uncertainty, and predict future asset returns.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了18万亿个模型，用于公司债券和股票回报的联合定价。引人注目的是，我们发现，一旦考虑了国债期限结构风险，仅凭股权和不可交易因素就足以解释公司债券的风险溢价，这使得广泛的债券因子文献在此目的上显得大为多余。尽管只有少数几个因子，包括行为性和不可交易性的，可能是定价风险的稳健来源，但真实的潜在随机贴现因子在可观测因子空间中是密集的。因此，贝叶斯模型平均随机贴现因子通过最优地聚合数十个作为共同潜在风险噪声代理的因子，在样本内和样本外均优于所有低维模型，解释了风险溢价，实现了1.5至1.8的样本外夏普比率。该SDF及其条件均值和波动性具有持续性，追踪商业周期和经济不确定性加剧时期，并能预测未来资产回报。
title: The co-pricing factor zoo
title_zh: 共同定价因子动物园

abstract: This paper investigates the role of international air connectivity in shaping regional industrial specialization through its impact on manufacturing firm entry. Leveraging granular data on international airlines originated from China during the 2010s, we construct county-specific foreign market air access measure. To address endogeneity, we employ a shift–share IV strategy that isolates exogenous variations in global air service from local factors. Our findings reveal that counties experiencing greater expansions in foreign air access exhibit higher entry rates in industries where China's exports hold stronger revealed comparative advantages. Mechanism analysis indicates that improved air connectivity boosts export activity and profitability, disproportionately expand exports among young exporters, and foster trade in new product and destination markets. We also provide evidence that air connectivity mitigates contracting frictions by facilitating face-to-face interactions. Overall, our results highlight international air connectivity as an important driver of endogenous spatial sorting and export-biased industrial growth.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了国际航空连通性如何通过影响制造业企业进入，进而塑造区域产业专业化。利用2010年代源自中国的国际航空公司细粒度数据，我们构建了县级层面的外国市场航空通达度指标。为应对内生性问题，我们采用偏移-份额工具变量策略，从本地因素中分离出全球航空服务的外生变动。研究发现，外国航空通达度扩张更大的县，在中国出口具有较强显性比较优势的行业中，企业进入率更高。机制分析表明，改善的航空连通性促进了出口活动和盈利能力，不成比例地扩大了年轻出口企业的出口规模，并推动了新产品和目的地市场的贸易。我们还提供了证据，表明航空连通性通过促进面对面互动缓解了契约摩擦。总体而言，我们的研究结果凸显了国际航空连通性作为内生空间分选和出口偏向型产业增长的重要驱动因素。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Air access to foreign markets and export-biased growth: Evidence from business entries
title_zh: 航空通达性与出口偏向型增长：基于企业进入的证据

abstract: Tutoring programs for low-performing students, delivered in-person or online, effectively enhance school performance, yet their medium- and longer-term impacts on labor market outcomes remain less understood. To address this gap, we conduct a randomized controlled trial with 839 secondary school students in Germany to examine the effects of an online tutoring program for low-performing students on academic performance and school-to-work transitions. The online tutoring program had a non-significant intention-to-treat effect of 0.06 standard deviations on math grades six months after program start. However, among students who had not received other tutoring services prior to the intervention, the program significantly improved math grades by 0.14 standard deviations. Moreover, students in non-academic school tracks experienced smoother school-to-work transitions, with vocational training take-up 18 months later being 5 percentage points higher—an effect that was even larger (12 percentage points) among those without prior tutoring. Overall, the results indicate that tutoring can generate lasting benefits for low-performing students that extend beyond school performance.
abstract_zh: 针对低学业表现学生的辅导项目，无论是面对面还是在线形式，均能有效提升学业成绩，但其对劳动力市场结果的中期及长期影响仍知之甚少。为填补这一研究空白，我们在德国对839名中学学生开展了一项随机对照试验，以考察一项针对低学业表现学生的在线辅导项目对学业表现及从学校到工作过渡的影响。该在线辅导项目在项目启动六个月后，对数学成绩的意向治疗效应为0.06个标准差，但未达到统计显著性。然而，在干预前未接受过其他辅导服务的学生中，该项目显著提高了数学成绩，增幅为0.14个标准差。此外，非学术型学校轨道的学生经历了更顺畅的学校到工作过渡，18个月后职业培训参与率高出5个百分点——这一效应在先前未接受辅导的学生中更为显著，达到12个百分点。总体而言，研究结果表明，辅导项目能为低学业表现学生带来超越学业表现的持久益处。
title: Online tutoring, school performance, and school-to-work transitions: Evidence from a randomized controlled trial
title_zh: 在线辅导、学业表现与从学校到工作的过渡：来自随机对照试验的证据

abstract: Pass-through rates are relevant in a variety of contexts, such as estimating antitrust damages. It is often asserted that focal pricing, the practice of charging only special prices, e.g. ending in 9s, reduces the degree of pass-through in an industry. This claim has had serious consequences; for example, it has contributed to the dismissal of high-profile antitrust cases. However, it is not grounded in economic theory or evidence. I prove that, in a simple but general framework, expected pass-through is unchanged by the presence of focal pricing constraints. Therefore, the fact that an industry is characterised by focal pricing constraints does not entail that it will also be characterised by a low pass-through rate.
abstract_zh: 通过率在多种情境下具有重要意义，例如在估算反垄断损害赔偿时。常有观点认为，焦点定价——即仅收取特定价格（如以9结尾的价格）的做法——会降低行业内的通过率。这一论断已产生严重后果；例如，它曾导致备受瞩目的反垄断案件被驳回。然而，这一说法并无经济学理论或实证依据。我证明，在一个简单但普遍的框架下，焦点定价约束的存在并不会改变预期的通过率。因此，一个行业存在焦点定价约束，并不意味着该行业也会表现出较低的通过率。
source_issue: International Journal of Industrial Organization, Volume 107
title: Focal pricing constraints and pass-through of input cost changes
title_zh: 焦点定价约束与投入成本变化的传导

abstract: Gul and Pesendorfer (2015) introduce subjective sources in Hurwicz expected utility: event domains on which binary bets are ranked as if by a prior and this “as if” behavior varies continuously with the event. Motivated by the certainty effect, I relax continuity only at the extremes, allowing discontinuities at impossible and certain events while maintaining continuity for non-degenerate bets. I characterize these non-extreme-outcome (neo)-continuous sources by a conditional power-series link between source probability and inner probability on an ideal core event. On acts measurable with respect to a neo-continuous source, the Hurwicz functional admits a rank-dependent representation on non-extreme ranks together with an extreme-outcome term.
abstract_zh: Gul和Pesendorfer（2015）在Hurwicz期望效用中引入了主观来源：在事件域上，二元赌注的排序如同依据先验概率进行，且这种“如同”行为随事件连续变化。受确定性效应启发，我仅在极端情形下放宽连续性，允许在不可能事件和必然事件处出现不连续，同时保持非退化赌注的连续性。我通过一个条件幂级数联系，将来源概率与理想核心事件上的内概率相关联，从而刻画了这些非极端结果（新）连续来源。对于相对于新连续来源可测的行为，Hurwicz泛函在非极端秩上允许秩依赖表示，并附带一个极端结果项。
title: The certainty effect and neo-continuous subjective sources in Hurwicz expected utility
title_zh: 确定性效应与赫尔维茨期望效用中的新连续主观来源
